{{Top}}
'''Dams''' were built to form artificial lakes for the purpose of storing water or other liquids. They were used for various means in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Examples of dams included [[Tiercam Dam]] on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] and the [[Yalara]] [[Yalara dam|dam]].
